title: docs(spec): manage_connector_connections comments name the organization administrators' default grant
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-tesla"} -->
_Requested by **Tesla** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01AXsQkLFKRdQCqQ3RTr6Jao?thread=cmsg_01AXsQkLFKRdQCqQ3RTr6JaoLXAkT8qKBzZ1B3UVHJPkjN)_

Fixes #28453

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：`packages/spec` 里三处注释改为如实写明：平台管理员与两个组织管理员权限集（`organization_admin`、`organization_admin_no_bypass`）默认持有 `manage_connector_connections`，其它岗位仍需显式授予。只改注释，不改任何代码、能力清单或测试断言。
- 为什么改：#28441（裁决 B，记录 6545223261）已让组织管理员默认持有该能力，旧注释仍说"组织管理员也要显式授予"，会让读 spec 的作者和 AI 多加一条重复授权，或误告客户管理员没有这项权利。
- 风险与回滚：零运行时风险；去注释后的 TypeScript 输出与 main 逐文件相同（见 Verification）。回滚即 revert。
- 先看：`packages/spec/src/security/capabilities.ts` 的 `manage_connector_connections` 注释；`packages/spec/src/identity/platform-admin-capabilities.test.ts` 改指向的 pin；`packages/spec/src/identity/eval-user.zod.ts`。
- 两分钟验证：`git grep -n "organization administrator included" -- packages/spec`，预期无命中。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

## What changes

Three comments, reworded to what #28441 ships (ruling B, record 6545223261): platform administrators and the two shipped organization-administrator sets, `organization_admin` and `organization_admin_no_bypass`, hold `manage_connector_connections` by default, and every other position holds it only by explicit grant.

- `packages/spec/src/security/capabilities.ts`: the `PLATFORM_CAPABILITIES` row's line comment.
- `packages/spec/src/identity/eval-user.zod.ts`: the line comment above the entry in `ADMIN_FULL_ACCESS_CAPABILITIES.systemPermissions`.
- `packages/spec/src/identity/platform-admin-capabilities.test.ts`: the case comment now says the organization-administrator sets hold it, and points at the pin #28441 added in plugin-security's `default-permission-sets.test.ts`, the case `[ADR-0143 D5] the connector connection capability ships with the platform administrator and both organization-administrator sets, and no other`, which asserts the exact holder list.

No code, capability list or test assertion changes.

**Contract review:** none owed. No `.describe()` and no exported TSDoc moved: all three edits are `//` line comments inside initializers, not declaration docblocks.

**Changeset:** none (label `skip-changeset`). Measured after `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec build` on 4f75d57d: the new wording is absent from every `dist/**/*.d.ts` / `.d.mts` file (control: the capability's `description` string is found in dist). The bundler does carry the line comments into the `dist` JS chunks, so the comment bytes there change; no symbol, value or type does.

**Grep:** `git grep -n "manage_connector_connections" -- packages/spec skills content/docs` after the edit shows no other spec sentence that contradicts the default grant. Hits outside `packages/spec`: `content/docs/automation/connectors.mdx:535` already says organization administrators hold it by default (updated in #28441); no hit in `skills/`.

## Tests

`pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 src/identity/platform-admin-capabilities.test.ts` on 4f75d57d: `Test Files 1 passed (1)`, `Tests 6 passed (6)`. No ablation: no tested behaviour moved.

## Acceptance notes

- Branch `claude/project-thread-1t227a` is the card thread's platform-assigned branch; claim 6546643088 names it.
- `content/docs/permissions/permission-sets.mdx` (the `organization_admin` summary row) was already judged out of scope in #28441's notes, since that row lists a subset of capabilities; not touched here.
